description: Click an element on the page identified by CSS selector. Auto-waits up to 5 seconds for the element to appear (MutationObserver). Scrolls the element into view before clicking. Returns the tag name and text of the clicked element. When a real mouse click (inside a frame, or with entropy) was pressed but the page changed under the press so the release missed the target, nothing is clicked again by script and the first line is JSON {"clicked": false, "reason": "moved"|"gone"|"unknown"} (isError stays false): the page may already have reacted to the press, so check it before retrying.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to click (e.g. '#submit-btn', '.nav a', 'button[type=submit]'). Inside an iframe (cross-origin too): 'iframe#card >>> button#pay'

name: browser_click
